_to parameter is purely local input to transfer and should be folded into the transfer node
_value parameter is purely local input to transfer and should be folded into the transfer node
_from parameter is purely local input to transferFrom and should be folded into the transferFrom node
toBurn is a transient computation inside transfer and should be merged into the transfer node
finalValue is a transient computation inside transfer and should be merged into the transfer node
toBurnFrom is a transient computation inside transferFrom and should be merged into the transferFrom node
finalValueFrom is a transient computation inside transferFrom and should be merged into the transferFrom node
